svg.title: Neighbour counts on a made-up 6x6 grid and the removal passes
svg.desc: In the first pass 5 rolls have fewer than 4 neighbouring rolls and are removed; repeating the pass removes the rest of the grid over 9 passes, 27 rolls in total.

g.text: Count the 8 neighbours of every roll
part 1 = accessible in the first pass = 5
each pass reads the old board and writes
removals into a deep copy, so all rolls of
one round are removed at the same time
part 2: repeat passes until one removes nothing
